title: Fixed Guided Pinsetting Deck Machine
description: One newly authored complete fixed pinsetting-machine visual display. A grounded braced double-side chassis has four whole guide shafts and bored setting-deck carriage sleeves. Four connected full perforated row plates have one, two, three and four real through-apertures in a triangular ten-position layout, supported on full crossrails. A distinct low sweep bar belongs to two side journal arms. Upper fixed lift links, a rear housing and transverse shaft with end discs complete the machinery exterior. No old bowling pins, lane or loose balls imported or counted; not a scaled desk plunger or inclined carnival target table with extra holes. Three opaque untextured constant PBR roles; metres, Z up and whole horizontal ground centering. One whole machine prop and zero scenes. Static empty illustrative machinery appearance only: no pin compatibility, feeding or gripping internals, ball return, regulation geometry, lifting or sweep motion, complete drive transmission, operating instructions, power, load, fabrication or safety claim.
